control_failures.control_label: mechanical support of a load during maintenance access

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: potential incident during an intrusive maintenance task on CV-3102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on CV-3102 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically removing isolation and returning to operations. CV-3102 (plant conveyors) is in service for coarse ore and reclaim conveying. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 12 February 2017 a potential incident was recorded on CV-3102 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during an intrusive maintenance task; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
